answer: Farming becomes a dawn bet on surviving 91 epochs of grading, and every velvet settlement recomputes the karst schedule, so anyone who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 91 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is as a result worth nothing for 10 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 6 dollars per alias. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
